'''Ki'at Thavo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], visiting both [[Carrick Station]] and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />
